spanish: Y en alargar la nube sobre el mishkán días muchos, y guardarán hijos de Israel guarda de Jehová, y no partirán.

findings.issue: Common noun (H4908, definite singular, not a proper name) is left as the Hebrew transliteration mishkán; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: Other tokens match in order, person, number, and stem; את is only the object marker.
